Description: National legislation, policy and regulatory components that govern how health information is stored, accessed and shared across geographical and health-sector boundaries.
Examples:
Unique health identifier regimes
Privacy, protection, storage and retention of personal health information
Consumer protection including in the online environment
Access and consent to personal health information use and disclosure, including secondary use
Audit and complaint procedures (e.g. such as those required for suspected breaches of privacy)
Licensing regimes which may be needed to ensure that private operators of components of a national eHealth environment meet required standards for privacy, integrity and security

Description: Broader public policy required to support the development of a national eHealth environment.
Examples:
Health sector policy (e.g. reform, improved access to and use of health information)
Non-health sector policy (e.g. broader industry and economic development, utilization of existing eGovernment infrastructure)
Policies to stimulate and manage innovation, risk, evaluation of feasibility and utility of services

Description: Policies specifically governing eHealth services, including privacy of health-related data held in digitized format, its use and sharing for research and the public interest.
Examples:
Policies on medical jurisdiction, liability for eHealth services (e.g. telemedicine), safety, data integrity and quality of care
Policies for reimbursement for eHealth services (e.g. telemedicine), both public and private
Policies for managing Internet health information quality, sales of medicines and regulated health products
Policies to demonstrate eHealth outcomes and clinical effectiveness

Description: Components required to support the development of eHealth products and which are compatible with the national eHealth environment.
Examples:
Development of national eHealth standards and other interoperability requirements
Compliance, conformance and accreditation of eHealth products and services
